5773.title: [M156] Integrate AA subset clamping and image-filter cache fixes
5773.body:
[M156] Integrate AA subset clamping and image-filter cache fixes (#5773)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/460
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5779
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/34fd542cf1ef15e3f76c90c3db96d227186af0ce...0d6629ea961e42997af39b060c099a471b6088e1

Bring the m156 image-filter and Ganesh correctness fixes into
release/4.156.x without changing package versions, dependency policy or
the public C ABI. Advance externals/skia and its cgmanifest registration
to the actual native merge, 0d6629ea961e42997af39b060c099a471b6088e1,
and record upstream 27c31ca4152b5b5790d54ce1c8273f139f051a8d.

~~ Keep AA sampling within the intended texture subset ~~

Coverage AA and MSAA can extrapolate texture coordinates beyond the
original quad. Under minification or strong skew, the extrapolation can
exceed a half-texel inset or one-pixel image-filter padding and sample
slack in approximate-fit backing textures.

Import upstream scale-aware subset checks, logical proxy-bounds clamping
for single and batched Ganesh draws, and strict source constraints for
non-pixel-aligned transparent-border draws. Avoid treating the source
rectangle as a safe sampling domain when AA clips, MSAA/DMSAA or mask
expansion invalidate that assumption. Preserve the DMSAA guard ordering
needed before querying clip AA.

Upstream regressions exercise AA-clipped minified and skewed blurs,
strict subsets, fragment-processor fallbacks and approximate-fit texture
draws, checking that red scratch pixels do not contaminate the output.
Hardware backend coverage still depends on executing the relevant cases;
several native GPU cases require successful surface creation.

~~ Match image-filter cache equality to its representation hash ~~

The cache hashes complete key bytes, while numerical equality omitted
matrix type-mask differences and could equate distinct floating-point
representations. Import bytewise equality so equal keys follow the same
representation contract as the hash.

Upstream tests distinguish signed-zero and matrix type-mask keys,
exercise colliding subnormal translations, and verify LRU eviction and
purge when probe order differs from LRU order.

~~ Pin the merged native history without changing the reviewed tree ~~

Use the native release-branch merge rather than leaving the submodule
on the reviewed PR head. Verify that the merge has exactly two parents,
directly includes reviewed 9b4d4e066afc1e074daf621a2bd178359d901c3b,
and retains tree af328dd38fff557f01c9f96271b3d5602e2f38fb.

Dependent PR #5779 changes only the gitlink and the corresponding mono/skia
commitHash. Both now identify the same verified merge, while the
upstream provenance continues to identify the imported m156 source.

Independent regeneration matched all five maintained binding outputs.
Source review retained 72 upstream-area and 106 interop-area fork patches
unchanged, with no DEPS file change. That review did not execute native
regression binaries or rerun the managed test solution.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5742.title: [M156] Integrate mask-filtered glyph hardening
5742.body:
[M156] Integrate mask-filtered glyph hardening (#5742)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/454
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/712ea097151d4951652dee046a8944376fd8df1b...34fd542cf1ef15e3f76c90c3db96d227186af0ce

Advance externals/skia and its cgmanifest registration to the merged
release/4.156.x native commit
34fd542cf1ef15e3f76c90c3db96d227186af0ce, integrating chrome/m156 through
4c5f57e4fa037da858ef66420903d5734fd6b363.

Adopt SkScalerContext::getImage hardening for consecutive glyph loads
that disagree about paths, mask formats, or bounds. The native change
uses the reloaded glyph's path, restricts overlap copies to matching
byte-per-pixel masks, and preserves full plane strides when clipping
embossed glyphs. This avoids stale-path rendering, sub-byte buffer
overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared 3D mask planes.

Record the upstream revision in cgmanifest alongside the actual fork
merge SHA. The native merge directly contains the reviewed head and has
the identical tree, so the final repin preserves the reviewed code.
This servicing update changes neither managed bindings nor release-line
version declarations.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>

5724.title: Fix OpenJDK validation with JVM diagnostics and task retries
5724.body:
Match javac's version at the start of any output line so JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS diagnostics do not reject a valid JDK. Keep exit-code and requested-major validation unchanged, and overwrite archive files on retry after a complete or partial extraction.
